output.sql: SELECT method, COUNT(payment_id) AS payment_count, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM marts.fct_payments WHERE paid_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND paid_at < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY method ORDER BY method
output.explanation: Counts and sums payments with a paid_at date in calendar year 2025, grouped by payment method. All payments received in that year are included, whatever the order date or status.
